mitoem2.0.name: mitoem2.0
mitoem2.0.description: MitoEM2.0 multi-domain generalization benchmark (8 sub-datasets), defined as a split OVERLAY over existing MitoVerse source volumes — no duplicated data. ME2-Jurkat/Macro/Podo are the (256,1024,1024) test0/test1 crops in openorganelle. ME2-Pyra is a masked crop/region of wei20/mitoEM-H. ME2-Sperm = kunduri22.

ME2-Sperm.source: kunduri22 (gt not connected across train01/train02 yet)

volumes.note: ME2-Pyra = masked 512-crops (train) + held-out region (test) of this single volume; use regions once PyTC supports them

cellmap.name: cellmap
cellmap.description: CellMap segmentation-challenge benchmark over the OpenOrganelle volumes (CellMap-annotated _crop volumes). The _test0/_test1 volumes are lab self-annotated and belong to mitoem2.0, so they are excluded here. Official challenge train/val/test to be applied; all listed as train for now.

guay21.name: guay21
guay21.description: Guay'21 dense-cell platelet (SBF-SEM). Runnable example: 3 original-chunk volumes, one per split.
